item.description:
Send from the right address

  • Choose a default From address when your Gmail can send from more than one.
  • Replies come from the address the email was sent to, and the reply box shows which one, with a menu to change it.
  • Settings → Gmail is redesigned: your account, sending, sync and Google services (Calendar and Tasks) in clear cards.

Nothing is sent without you.

Mail from the keyboard

  • R replies to the open email, E marks it done (archives it and opens the next one), and U marks it read or unread.
  • ⌘Delete still moves it to Trash with Undo, and ↑ ↓ and Esc move around.
  • Shortcuts pause while you type, and the list footer shows them.

Nothing is sent, archived or deleted without you.

Tasks, calendar and Ask Cove, smoother

  • Ask Cove creates Google Tasks from an email ("create a task and archive this"), finds your meetings with someone over the past year, and knows who "Manuel" is in the email you're reading.
  • Emails show the tasks made from them, payment requests get a Create task button, and a new date picker sets due dates.
  • New events: invite guests with a Google Meet link, or press + and describe it ("30 min with Manuel, first open spot") — Cove finds the time in your real calendar.
  • Meetings link their Gemini notes and transcripts, and ⌘Delete deletes the selected event after asking.
  • An empty inbox tab shows a quiet dotted sunset, the Inbox count now means unread Important mail, and broken accents like "botÃ³n" read correctly.

Nothing is sent, created or deleted without you.
